title: DCLab Code: plan approval card, own copies (git worktrees) and records into R&D's store
request: Fix the 3 gaps first: the plan approval card, records into R&D's training store, and worktrees for parallel sessions.
plan: Probe what the SDK sends for ExitPlanMode instead of guessing
Plan card with approve (auto edits / ask) or keep planning
Read R&D's store keepers; add a keeper in R&D for the app's records
Worktrees where Claude Code puts them so R&D's agents keeper keeps their transcripts
Two reviews, fixes with tests, live checks on fake data

decisions.why: The typed input had no plan field; at runtime it carries plan and planFilePath
R&D already excludes the folder locally and its agents keeper keeps sessions there

decisions.decision: Link git-ignored envs (.venv, .env, node_modules) into the copy
decisions.why: R&D commands use .venv/bin/python; a copy without it cannot run them

decisions.decision: A separate test home and port for live checks
decisions.why: The owner had the app running; two servers sharing sessions.json overwrite each other's index

change: ExitPlanMode as a plan card; a git worktree per session under .claude/worktrees with merge and remove that refuse whenever they could touch the person's work; the sealed guard extended to the copies; R&D keeper 32.33.

findings.defect: put() returned nothing, so every note was empty and a saved session stopped drawing at its first note
findings.scenario: seen when: put() returned nothing, so every note was empty and a saved session stopped drawing at its first note
findings.fix: put returns the node; one event that fails to draw never stops the rest (safeApply)
findings.test: seen live; no page tests yet

findings.defect: Merge wiped a merge the person had in progress
findings.scenario: seen when: Merge wiped a merge the person had in progress
findings.fix: refuse during merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert or bisect; abort only our own merge
findings.test: server test: the hand-resolved file survives

findings.defect: Merge silently replaced git-ignored files in the main folder (results/run.json)
findings.scenario: seen when: Merge silently replaced git-ignored files in the main folder (results/run.json)
findings.fix: refuse when the branch adds a path that already exists in the main folder

findings.defect: The sealed guard skipped .claude (the copies) and, in a copy, never saw the main folder's git-ignored sealed rows
findings.scenario: seen when: The sealed guard skipped .claude (the copies) and, in a copy, never saw the main folder's git-ignored sealed rows
findings.fix: .claude/worktrees counts as sealed when the project has sealed files; in a copy the main folder's sealed folders are checked too

findings.scenario: seen when: Merge target never checked
findings.fix: detached HEAD refused; another branch asks first; the confirm names the branch

findings.defect: Remove raced background jobs and new messages, and deleted ignored outputs without saying
findings.scenario: seen when: Remove raced background jobs and new messages, and deleted ignored outputs without saying
findings.fix: refused while a background job runs; the agent closed and messages blocked first; ignored outputs listed before a forced removal (caches left out)

findings.defect: A message while the copy was being made ran in the main folder
findings.scenario: seen when: A message while the copy was being made ran in the main folder
findings.fix: creating flag blocks messages; a restart marks a half-made copy failed; a failed create removes the half-made worktree

findings.defect: A plan file link inside ~/.claude/plans could point anywhere
findings.scenario: seen when: A plan file link inside ~/.claude/plans could point anywhere
findings.fix: realpath checked against the real plans folder

findings.defect: R&D keeper would have kept other folders' sessions whole (the main product, a client's data)
findings.scenario: seen when: R&D keeper would have kept other folders' sessions whole (the main product, a client's data)
findings.fix: R&D 32.33 keeps this repository's sessions only, counts the rest

measurements.name: dclab-code test suite with a fake agent
measurements.gate: every test passes before the commit
limits: merge cases on temporary repositories, not the owner's

outcome: Plans are approved in a card, parallel sessions work in their own copies, and the app's records reach R&D's store for sessions on R&D only.
lessons: Probe an SDK tool's real input before building its UI
A helper's missing return value can hide a whole class of UI: test the page, not only the server
Every git operation on the person's main folder must refuse whenever it cannot prove it changes nothing else
risks: a git operation on the person's main folder that changes more than it says
